title: Autocomplete that behaves itself
summary: A search-as-you-type box that works with a mouse and nothing else. Debounce the typing, call off the search nobody wants, drive it from the keyboard, and give it the roles a combobox is supposed to have.

checkpoints.title: It waits for the typing to stop
checkpoints.hint: Start a timer in the effect and clear it in the cleanup, so each keystroke replaces the pending search instead of adding one. The component is handed a debounceMs, so use it rather than a number of your own.

checkpoints.title: A late answer cannot overwrite a newer one
checkpoints.hint: Two searches in flight will land in whatever order they like. An AbortController per effect, aborted in the cleanup, settles it. Remember that an abort rejects, and that rejection is not a failure worth showing anyone.

checkpoints.title: The keyboard drives the list
checkpoints.hint: Hold the highlighted index in state and move it on ArrowDown and ArrowUp. Enter takes the highlighted one and only that one; Escape closes the list and chooses nothing.

checkpoints.title: A screen reader can follow it
checkpoints.hint: role=combobox on the input with aria-expanded and aria-controls, role=listbox on the list, role=option on each row. Focus stays in the input the whole time, so aria-activedescendant is what says which option is highlighted.
